test_title: PYST 46: SSC CGL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: The average marks (out of 100) of boys and girls in an examination are 75 and 80, respectively. If the average marks of all the students in that examination are 78. Find the ratio of the number of boys to the number of girls.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

By using the rule of Alligation:

Ratio of Boys to Girls = (Average of Girls − Overall Average) : (Overall Average − Average of Boys)

Ratio = (80 − 78) : (78 − 75)

Ratio = 2 : 3

**∴ The correct answer is 2 : 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average marks of boys = 75

Average marks of girls = 80

Overall average marks = 78

 Ratio = 2 : 3

**Formula Used:**

Overall Average = (Total marks of boys + Total marks of girls) ÷ Total number of students

**Calculation:**

Let the number of boys be x and the number of girls be y.

⇒ Total marks of boys = 75 × x

⇒ Total marks of girls = 80 × y

⇒ Total marks of all students = 78 × (x + y)

⇒ 75x + 80y = 78(x + y)

⇒ 75x + 80y = 78x + 78y

⇒ 80y − 78y = 78x − 75x

⇒ 2y = 3x

⇒ x/y = 2/3

**∴ The correct answer is 2 : 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Alligation Rule

It is a method used to easily find the ratio in which two or more items or groups at given averages/prices must be mixed to produce a desired overall average.

Weighted Average

When combining two groups with different individual averages, the combined overall average is weighted by the respective number of quantities in each group: Average = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Ratio & Proportion

A ratio establishes a mathematical relationship between two quantities of the same kind, represented as a fraction. If a : b = x : y, then a/b = x/y.
